# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 72 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 72 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_072_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 8, Part 3 — More Rod Categories

**72:1** "Those who turned in rods more dry than green — these are people who believed but lived a double life. They did some good things, but also a lot of bad. Some of them repented and landed in the first tower; others repented and ended up in the second tower; others didn't repent at all. Those ones are still sitting with the unrepentant."

**72:2** "Those who turned in rods more green than dry — these mostly lived well, though they committed some evil, and they hadn't been among the faithful for very long. They repented quickly when they heard my commandments. Their place is in the first tower."

**72:3** "Those who turned in rods that were green but dried at the tips — these were consistently good and faithful people, but they had some envy and quarreling among themselves over questions of status and rank. When they heard my words, most of them repented quickly — their place is in the first tower. A few were double-minded and ended up in the second tower."

**72:4** "Those who turned in rods half-green and half-dry — these people had gotten deeply wrapped up in business and had drifted away from the holy community. That's why they're half alive and half dead. Many of them repented when they heard my commandments and now live in the first tower. But some were completely double-minded and fell away entirely — those people have lost their lives."

**72:5** "Those who turned in rods that were fully green and had shoots with fruit — these are people who suffered for the name of the Lord, who held on with their whole heart, and who even gave up their lives."

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, making the rod-typology of Similitude 8 and its pastoral categories vivid and comprehensible.*
